note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: AI data centers face heatwave and severe-weather climate risks
items.blurb: Record heat is now the leading loss driver for US data-center builders, pressuring the AI compute buildout.

items.title: Pro-AI camp fractures over government limits on OpenAI and Anthropic models
items.blurb: White House had OpenAI stage GPT-5.6's rollout, mirroring the Fable 5 freeze; critics warn the reviews could stall the US market.

items.title: Anthropic's Mythos is coming back for a select group of entities approved by the U.S. government
items.blurb: After daily talks, Lutnick determined safeguards were adequate for 'trusted partners'; broad access and consumer Fable 5 remain restricted.

items.title: How GE Vernova builds the gas turbines powering the AI data center boom
items.blurb: Turbine backlogs and power constraints emerge as the binding limit on AI buildout as compute demand outpaces the grid.

items.title: Scoop: Powerful Anthropic model, Fable 5, on track to return soon
items.blurb: Consumer Fable 5, offline 15 days under a US export order, could be reinstated within days as negotiations progress.

items.title: OpenAI limits new AI models to 'trusted partners' at request of U.S. government
items.blurb: GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna launched only to ~20 government-vetted partners — the access-review regime that hit Anthropic now extends to OpenAI.

items.title: OpenAI releases powerful new GPT-5.6 model under restrictions
items.blurb: Three GPT-5.6 tiers — Sol, Terra, Luna — debut in limited preview to ~20 approved firms; broad release pegged to a federal cyber framework.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic face new AI reality as users shift from 'tokenmaxxing' to efficiency
items.blurb: As IPOs near, buyers demand ROI over raw capability; some startups swap frontier Claude for cheaper open models like DeepSeek.

items.title: Nvidia, Alphabet sit out megacap tech bounce as chip stocks sink
items.blurb: SoftBank-led Asian tech selloff and AI-infrastructure cost worries keep chip names under pressure into the week's close.

items.title: OpenAI is reportedly delaying its IPO. Here's when Kalshi traders think it will announce
items.blurb: OpenAI confidentially filed in June but may push its public debut to 2027; Kalshi prices a formal announcement near 59% by March 2027.

items.title: Trump admin allows Anthropic to release Mythos AI model to some companies, government agencies
items.blurb: Commerce cleared the pulled Mythos 5 for ~100 vetted US critical-infrastructure orgs — first softening of the Jun 12 freeze; Fable 5 stays banned.

items.title: China's Zhipu closes in on top U.S. models as Anthropic and OpenAI sit gated
items.blurb: Open-weight GLM line narrows the gap to gated U.S. frontier models, helped by export-control limbo on Fable 5 and GPT-5.6.

items.title: SK Hynix prepares U.S. listing at $166 per share — HSBC says it could be worth 20% more
items.blurb: Nvidia memory supplier prices its ~$29B Nasdaq ADR listing, set for July 10, as AI-driven memory demand surges.

items.title: China's AI progress strains U.S. alliance pitch
items.blurb: Cheap, capable Chinese open models complicate Washington's effort to rally allies behind a US-led AI and chip bloc.

items.title: Anthropic and OpenAI Foundation back Raimondo's $500M effort to prepare workers for AI
items.blurb: 'Raise Us' will test wage insurance, retraining incentives and AI career coaching in four states as labor disruption mounts.

items.title: Micron soars 15% after blockbuster earnings, lifting chip stocks
items.blurb: Memory maker's revenue quadrupled to $41.5B on AI data-center demand, beating estimates and easing AI-bubble fears.

items.title: SK Hynix surges 12% after Micron earnings; blockbuster Nasdaq listing
items.blurb: Memory peers rallied on Micron's results as AI buildout keeps memory-chip demand and prices elevated.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: Micron steals Nvidia's margin king crown
items.blurb: Surging memory prices push Micron's margins past Nvidia's, reshaping who profits most from the AI compute boom.

items.title: Humans outperform AI at this highly rigorous mathematics test
items.blurb: A new benchmark, First Proof, posed ten unseen research-level math problems to four AI systems; all fell short of top human experts.

items.title: Trump administration asks OpenAI to limit next model release over security concerns
items.blurb: First time the US government preemptively asked an American AI firm to restrict a model launch while it builds a security-testing framework.

items.title: Anthropic's hiring spree reveals where it's building AI data centers next
items.blurb: Anthropic is recruiting data-center engineers in Australia and Japan as rapid growth strains its overseas compute capacity.

items.title: OpenAI and Broadcom reveal Jalapeno, first AI chip in partnership
items.blurb: First OpenAI-Broadcom co-designed chip, built in nine months, targets initial deployment by end of 2026 to ease GPU dependence.

items.title: Qualcomm inks deal for AI startup Modular to bolster software stack, data center build-out
items.blurb: Qualcomm moves to acquire Modular for nearly $4 billion, expanding its data-center software position as AI compute demand surges.

items.title: Tech stocks try to rebound after global AI sell-off batters chip companies
items.blurb: Asian tech shares partly rebounded after a global AI-driven selloff cut chip stocks; Micron slid into its after-bell earnings.
